nodes.title: Brann the Smith
nodes.speaker: brann
nodes.text: Brann works the bellows without looking up. "Come back when you have something worth the fire," he says.

nodes.title: Brann the Smith
nodes.speaker: brann
nodes.text: The bellows stop. Brann stares at the green glow under your coat, then at you. "That," he says, "is worth the fire." [page] He takes your hand and holds it over the coals until the heat stops hurting and starts listening. "Forge-words. My father's. Call it and it comes."

nodes.title: Brann the Smith
nodes.speaker: brann
nodes.text: Brann sees the sword at your side and sets down his hammer. "That blade's mine: off my own rack, the night of the storm. Keep it. You've given it a better story than I could."
